chapter_title: 完整纯性与有限纯化的酉等价

numbered_results.title: 完整有限复密度空间的纯性刻画
assumptions: iota is a finite complex matrix carrier; equality is decidable in the Lean matrix interface.
rho : Density iota carries actual PSD and complex trace-one proofs.
IsPure means extremality in the entire Density iota convex set, not in a selected subset.
numbered_results.quantifiers: For every such iota and every rho : Density iota, both directions of the stated equivalence.
numbered_results.conclusion: IsPure rho iff there exists v : iota -> Complex with trace(outer v)=1 and rho.matrix=outer v.
proof_outline: PSD-derived Gram factor
sum of actual positive column outer products has total mass one
choose an actual positive-mass column
zero-remainder case via PSD zero mass iff zero matrix; positive-remainder case via full convex extremality
normalize selected column using positive square root
reuse existing vectorState_isPure for reverse implication
open_boundaries: No claim of a supplied rank-one/rank assumption; it is derived.
No independently certified numerical Gram/square-root algorithm.
Empty iota has no Density input; no additional Nonempty premise.
Finite complex model does not establish Core-to-complex selection.

numbered_results.title: 同辅助载体的完整纯化酉等价
assumptions: iota and alpha are finite complex carriers, with decidable equality.
Psi,Phi : Density (iota x alpha) are IsPure in the full joint Density type.
The actual RectangularChannel.discardRight iota alpha state outputs are equal.
numbered_results.quantifiers: For every finite system and common finite auxiliary carrier, and every pair of full convex-pure joint densities with equal actual system marginal.
numbered_results.conclusion: There exists U : Matrix alpha alpha Complex satisfying U^dagger U=I, U U^dagger=I and Phi.matrix=(I tensor U) Psi.matrix (I tensor U)^dagger. The unnormalized vector helper additionally fixes phi(i,a)=sum_b U(a,b) psi(i,b) exactly.
proof_outline: Full purity converse supplies normalized vector representatives for arbitrary pure densities
Actual marginal equals row Gram
Transpose to F=A^T,G=B^T and column Gram equality
Kernel quotient defines a support isometry Fx -> Gx
Finite same-space isometry extension gives a surjective unitary matrix
Recover U A^T=B^T and exact auxiliary vector action
Outer-product congruence yields the actual joint density relation
open_boundaries: The two original auxiliary carriers are the same type in this theorem.
U itself is not claimed unique; unused support complements and vector phase can vary.
No full-rank or pre-supplied unitary hypothesis.
No infinite-dimensional isometric-extension claim.

numbered_results.title: 辅助等距嵌入的实际通道、边际和纯性
assumptions: iota,alpha,beta are finite complex carriers with the decidable equality instances required by the actual matrix/channel interface.
J : Matrix beta alpha Complex satisfies J^dagger J=I_alpha.
numbered_results.quantifiers: Every actual rectangular auxiliary isometry J; marginal identity for every complex input matrix X : Operator (iota x alpha); purity preservation for every full convex-pure density Psi.
numbered_results.conclusion: The actual one-Kraus RectangularChannel with Kraus I tensor J is CPTP, leaves the system discardRight marginal invariant on all complex matrices and preserves full convex purity on the enlarged density space.
proof_outline: Tensor Kraus completeness from J^dagger J=I
Actual system-indexed block formula J X^{ij} J^dagger
Trace cycling gives tr(J X^{ij} J^dagger)=tr(X^{ij})
Full purity converse and outer_mulVec give normalized vector output; inherited trace preservation supplies normalization
open_boundaries: Rectangular isometry is not a two-sided unitary when auxiliary dimensions differ.
Completely positive amplification is inherited through the actual RectangularChannel API; no new physical principle is inserted.
No new numerical implementation certification is claimed.

numbered_results.title: 不同有限辅助载体的共同扩展酉等价
assumptions: iota,alpha,beta finite complex carriers, with decidable equality.
Psi : Density (iota x alpha) and Phi : Density (iota x beta) are each full convex-pure.
Their actual system discardRight marginal densities agree.
numbered_results.quantifiers: All such systems and finite auxiliary carriers alpha,beta without a dimension-order or equal-cardinality assumption; all such pure densities.
numbered_results.conclusion: Canonical actual left/right auxiliary isometries embed both densities into iota x (alpha Sum beta); both retain purity and marginal; there exists U on alpha Sum beta with both unitary identities that relates the embedded joint densities by I tensor U conjugation.
proof_outline: Canonical fromRows embeddings J_alpha=[I;0],J_beta=[0;I]
Separate isometry proofs with correctly typed source identities
Actual CPTP extensions and separate purity/marginal proofs
Apply same-carrier complete purity uniqueness only after common extension
open_boundaries: The common dimension is |alpha|+|beta|, not asserted minimal.
No rectangular two-sided unitary between the original spaces.
No direct whole-space isometry in an unspecified dimension direction.
A reconstruction principle with a prescribed padding convention requires a further explicit interface theorem.

numbered_results.title: 伴随、转置和逐项共轭不能替代实际辅助作用
assumptions: The action is exactly (I tensor T)psi1, with the second tensor index as auxiliary.
numbered_results.quantifiers: Three separate exact concrete inequalities, one each for T=U^dagger,U^T,conj(U).
numbered_results.conclusion: Each wrong-direction transformed joint outer-product density differs from outer psi2. Entries are respectively 108i/625 vs108/625, -108i/625 vs108/625 and144i/625 vs-144i/625.
proof_outline: Kernel-checked exact rational complex arithmetic on selected joint entries
Take the imaginary part of a putative matrix equality to contradict the concrete entry values
open_boundaries: These are joint-density inequalities, not claims that their system marginals differ.
A vector-only difference could be hidden by global phase; the accepted controls compare joint outer products.
Formal exact witnesses are not real experimental confirmation.

numbered_results.title: 严格辅助扩维是等距嵌入，不是双侧酉等价
assumptions: Fixed canonical auxiliaryInl from Fin 2 to Fin 2 Sum Unit.
Actual source/output auxiliary dimensions are 2 and 3.
numbered_results.quantifiers: One explicit rectangular embedding and its separate equality/inequality witnesses.
numbered_results.conclusion: J^dagger J=I_2, but JJ^dagger != I_3; at the extra Sum.inr Unit coordinate the latter product has diagonal zero while I_3 has one.
proof_outline: Invoke the proved generic canonical inclusion isometry
Compute the extra output diagonal under multiplication and derive 0!=1
Instantiate actual larger pure density and its unchanged system marginal; the separate common-extension witness uses a five-dimensional auxiliary sum
open_boundaries: The concrete common five-dimensional unitary is supplied by the proved general existence construction, not an independently listed numerical 5x5 matrix.
This does not negate isometric embeddings; it distinguishes them from two-sided unitary equivalence.
